requirements.quote:
+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   NSDNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

NSDNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a host which should be
                authoritative for the specified class and domain.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent NS RDATA as a single NSDNAME field encoded as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The NS RDATA encoder and parser can be checked for one domain-name field matching the illustrated layout.

requirements.quote:
NSDNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a host which should be
                authoritative for the specified class and domain.
requirements.condition: Interpreting the NSDNAME of an NS resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat NSDNAME as the name of a host that should be authoritative for the specified class and domain; this is an expectation of authority, not a guarantee that the target is authoritative.
requirements.why_checkable: The record interpretation and selection of an expected authoritative host can be checked against its NSDNAME, class, and domain.

requirements.quote:
NS records cause both the usual additional section processing to locate
a type A record, and, when used in a referral, a special search of the
zone in which they reside for glue information.
requirements.condition: Processing an NS record for additional-section information.
requirements.required_behavior: Perform the usual additional-section processing to locate a type A record for the named host.
requirements.why_checkable: An NS processing path can be exercised with a target host address record to observe the additional-record lookup.

requirements.quote:
NS records cause both the usual additional section processing to locate
a type A record, and, when used in a referral, a special search of the
zone in which they reside for glue information.
requirements.condition: Using an NS record in a referral.
requirements.required_behavior: Perform a special search for glue information in the zone in which the NS record resides.
requirements.why_checkable: A referral can be constructed with glue in the containing zone and the zone search can be observed.

requirements.quote:
The NS RR states that the named host should be expected to have a zone
starting at owner name of the specified class.
requirements.condition: Interpreting the zone expected at the host named by an NS resource record.
requirements.required_behavior: Expect the named host to have a zone starting at the NS record owner name in the specified class; preserve this as an expectation rather than a mandatory availability guarantee.
requirements.why_checkable: The zone apex and class associated with the NS target can be checked against the record owner and class.
